sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a simple article/detail page with static content: a site title/logo area, plain navigation links, a headline/date area, a large hero image, and body text. There are no visible controls such as hamburger icons, dropdown indicators, tabs, accordions, form fields, modal triggers, counters, or pagination/load-more affordances. The cross-viewport difference appears to be purely responsive layout rather than JavaScript-driven interaction, so the implied implementation is essentially static aside from ordinary link navigation handled by the browser.
